source.name: CNW / LG Electronics Canada: 'LG Electronics Canada and Maple Leaf Sports and Entertainment expands partnership to include Toronto FC'
source.quote: The new partnership will introduce the LG logo on the right sleeve of the team’s jerseys this season.
source.note: Multi-year partnership announced 17 July 2024; FOR SOCCER's 2026 MLS jersey-sponsor list (2026-02-17) still shows LG Electronics as Toronto FC's right-sleeve partner. No value reported.

note: Right-sleeve patch from the second half of the 2024 season; continuing in 2026. The same deal made LG the title sponsor of the West Club at BMO Field.
